verdicts.reason: A: the starry panel sits off-centre with a ragged right edge, the product can is a tiny thumbnail floating outside its panel next to empty space, the glow circle is detached at bottom-right and clips the Shop Now button, and the logo is pushed to the bottom. B has a cleaner grid, with the logo at top right, a full-width panel and aligned text, but the product can shrinks to a nearly invisible icon in the bottom-left corner, the panel is empty, and the orange circle collides behind the CTA. Both lose the hero product. B wins narrowly on structure and reading order.
